why_clarity: Cost and transit benchmarks are concrete and recomputed every rate cycle.
why_digital: Shipment records modelled and published as benchmarks on screen.

why_ai: Margin reconstruction and review checks are automatable, and the buyer segment has contracted.
why_clarity: Diligence checklists exist, but whether an acquisition pays off shows years later.
why_digital: Marketplace statements and listings analysed entirely on screen.

why_digital: Paperwork is digital, but physical goods cross borders to customers.

why_ai: Underwriting from marketplace sales data is classic credit modelling that machines already run.
why_clarity: Each advance is scored the same way, with repayment known months later.
why_digital: Connected sales data in, funding decisions out, all online.

why_ai: Sellers pick brokers for their buyer network and negotiating trust, not the valuation maths.
why_clarity: Earnings reconstruction is procedural, but each deal and valuation is negotiated.
why_digital: Online businesses valued and sold remotely through online listings.

why_ai: Market sizing and rankings from estimates and surveys are synthesis work AI reproduces.
why_clarity: Annual methods repeat, but revenue estimates are rarely verified.
why_digital: Estimates in, reports and memberships delivered online.

why_ai: Contributed brand sales data is a moat, but the estimation work is machine learning.
why_clarity: Category share is computed continuously against contributed sales for calibration.
why_digital: Scraped listings and contributed data in, analytics subscription out.

why_digital: Made by hand from physical materials and shipped, but sold through online marketplaces.

why_ai: Sales estimation from continuous scraping is a pure modelling product AI-native rivals can build.
why_clarity: Estimates are calibrated against connected sellers' true sales at scale.
why_digital: Scraped marketplace data in, subscription analytics out.

why_ai: Bid changes, keyword harvesting and pacing are rule-heavy tasks repeated hundreds of times daily.

why_ai: Pricing and bidding algorithms tuned on outcome data are machine learning by definition.

why_ai: Review insight extraction and fraud detection are language-model tasks on abundant text.

why_clarity: Ad and order data give fast feedback, but attribution and creative remain contested.
